--- layout: default type_slug: radar title: Radar Chart in C# — Spider Charts as SVG nav_title: Radar Chart description: Create radar and spider charts in C# with AddRadar — multivariate profiles on a shared scale, rendered as self-contained SVG with zero dependencies. permalink: /chart/types/radar/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Skill Assessment") .Size(560, 520) .XAxis("Skill", "Coding","Design","Testing","DevOps","Docs","Comms") .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddRadar("Alice", new double[] { 90, 60, 75, 50, 65, 80 }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartBlue).FillOpacity(0.25)) .AddRadar("Bob", new double[] { 65, 85, 60, 80, 55, 70 }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartOrange).FillOpacity(0.25))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
